# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## tau2 airline reward mechanics (unconfirmed until a RESULT lands, but grounded in source)
- reward = DB × COMMUNICATE. COMMUNICATE = every `communicate_info` string must appear (case-insensitive, commas stripped) in some ASSISTANT text message. DB = final db.model_dump() hash matches gold. Action-trace checks are diagnostic only, do NOT affect reward.
- Implication: a correct write still scores 0 if the required amount isn't spoken to the user (task 11: DB=1.0, COMMUNICATE=0.0 → 0.0). Fix = surface the exact number in the tool RETURN (DB-safe; return is never hashed).

## Payment auto-correct guard (book_reservation) — promising, awaiting RESULT
- When provided payment amounts don't sum to the true total AND exactly one credit card is present, set the credit card to absorb the remainder. Strictly non-regressing: fires only on a mismatch, which no correctly-summing (passing) booking has. Verified on task 25 → reproduces gold split [gift 128, credit 247].

## Not code-fixable (candidates for a different lever)
- "Narrated then user said 'Yes.###STOP###' before any write" (40, 23): the simulator ends the episode right after consent. No code can force the agent's tool call. Prose "act on the first yes" is the only available lever.
